title: Origin story: Perseus
description: Perseus was the son of Zeus and Danae, conceived when Zeus visited her as a shower of gold in her bronze prison tower. Cast adrift in a chest with his mother, he was raised on Seriphos, where King Polydectes tricked him into vowing to fetch the head of Medusa, whose gaze turned living flesh to stone.
